The fact that everyone else you've talked to holds a different view doesn't make my position wrong — that's an appeal to popularity. If anything, it might say something about the sample of people around you, or about how hard it is to criticize a system we're all embedded in.

I'm absolutely open to hearing actual arguments or evidence that would change my mind. But "everyone else disagrees" isn't one of them. I'd rather hold an honest, well-reasoned opinion that's unpopular than abandon it just to fit in. What do the researchers you mentioned actually say about the benefits?
